hook: The most dominant athlete in the world is... a horse?
story: His name was Frankel, a British thoroughbred. Between 2010 and 2012 he ran 14 races and won all 14. He won the 2000 Guineas by six lengths - called one of the greatest displays ever seen on a British racecourse. Bookmakers eventually priced him at one-to-twenty: bet twenty to win one. The betting market simply gave up pretending he could lose.
number: Since 1948, Timeform has rated every racehorse. For nearly fifty years, nothing scored above 145 - that was the top of the chart. Then Frankel made them redraw it: 147.
closer: Frankel retired at four years old. His new job pays 350,000 pounds per appointment.
full_text: The most dominant athlete in the world is... a horse? His name was Frankel, a British thoroughbred. Between 2010 and 2012 he ran 14 races and won all 14. He won the 2000 Guineas by six lengths - called one of the greatest displays ever seen on a British racecourse. Bookmakers eventually priced him at one-to-twenty: bet twenty to win one. The betting market simply gave up pretending he could lose. Since 1948, Timeform has rated every racehorse. For nearly fifty years, nothing scored above 145 - that was the top of the chart. Then Frankel made them redraw it: 147. Frankel retired at four years old. His new job pays 350,000 pounds per appointment.
